QUOTE: **Compile-time substitution:** define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`. ... **Runtime substitution:** define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` without the two macros.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair. It says runtime substitution applies "without the two macros", and that `platform.c` omits its runtime code when the macros are defined. Together these state that the two are mutually exclusive.
